summary: CCH Holdings Ltd, a Malaysian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing the September 30, 2026 subsequent closing of a July 31, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor. The company issued the remaining US$1,250,000 principal tranche of a Senior 8% OID convertible note, receiving US$1,035,000 (US$1,150,000 less a US$115,000 second-closing discount), bringing aggregate gross proceeds to US$2,185,000 on a US$2,500,000 note plus 374,112 warrants. A September 11 letter amendment eliminated the company's Floor Price reset right and capped aggregate economic difference at US$2,500,000.
